title: ExtensionDefinition
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of an AIP-40 EXTENSION.md manifest. An extension declares a workspace-local doctype that inherits a public AIP's schema — adding fields (add_fields), tightening constraints (tighten), selectively REMOVING non-required parent fields (remove_fields, guarded: parent-required fields refuse removal, mirroring AIP-18's inherited-status rule), choosing which aspects compose per-aspect (inherit: {schema, defaults, parse, path}; omitted = v1 wholesale inheritance), setting defaults, and overriding the path convention.

schema.description: Pins the spec version this manifest conforms to.

slug.description: Namespaced identifier — `<namespace>:<name>`. Lowercase, digits, dashes; single colon separator. Example: `acme:deal`.

description.description: One-paragraph statement of the extension's purpose.

version.description: Extension's own semver. Bump on breaking change.

status.description: Extensions are perpetually Local — they never enter the public registry's Draft/Review/Final lifecycle.

extends.description: Parent AIP this extension inherits from, or `none` for a root doctype.

properties.description: JSON Schema property definitions to merge into the parent's properties. Collisions are an error — use `tighten` to narrow an existing field.

required.description: Field names that become required in addition to parent's required[]. Unioned with parent's required, never replaces.

add_fields.description: Schema-level additions: new properties + new required entries.

tighten.description: Per-field constraint overrides. Each entry MUST tighten (not loosen) the parent's constraints; runtimes verify monotonicity at registration.

defaults.description: Default values applied when a field is omitted. Layered on top of parent's defaults; extension's value wins on the same key.

path_convention.description: Filesystem convention template, e.g. `"deals/<slug>/DEAL.md"`. Tokens: `<slug>` (doctype identity), `<DOCTYPE>` (extension's slug name part). Falls back to parent's convention when omitted.

requires.description: Public AIPs the extension depends on, in addition to its parent.

metadata.description: Free-form vendor extensions under namespaced keys (`metadata.<vendor>.<field>`).

remove_fields.description: OPTIONAL — parent property names this extension REMOVES from the inherited schema. GUARDED: a field listed in the parent's required[] MUST NOT be removed (removing it would invalidate parent-validated instances; mirrors AIP-18's 'children MUST NOT remove an inherited status'). Runtimes MUST refuse registration when the guard is violated. Also independent of `inherit.schema`: removing fields implies schema inheritance stays on.

schema.description: Inherit the parent's schema (properties/required minus remove_fields). When false, add_fields becomes the full schema (root-like composition).

defaults.description: Layer the parent's defaults under the extension's. When false, parent defaults are NOT applied.

parse.description: Reuse the parent's manifest parser. When false, the extension MUST supply its own parser at registration (root-doctype rule).

path.description: Fall back to the parent's pathOf convention. When false, path_convention becomes REQUIRED.

inherit.description: Per-aspect selection — choose which aspects of the parent compose, instead of AIP-40 v1's wholesale merge. Omitted keys default to true (backwards compatible with v1: wholesale inheritance).
